I couldn't find anything about configuring the Django admin site in these FastAPI docs. Django is a separate framework, so its own documentation is the place to look.

If you meant FastAPI's built-in API documentation interfaces, those are covered. You can configure the two documentation user interfaces included: Swagger UI: served at `/docs`.[4] You can set its URL with the parameter `docs_url`.[4] ReDoc: served at `/redoc`.[4] You can set its URL with the parameter `redoc_url`.[4]

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI(docs_url="/documentation", redoc_url=None)
```

More details: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/metadata/
